bridge_chains.description: Local constraint propagation (CSP) -> global lattice point existence question -> potential proof of non-existence via Brauer-Manin obstruction. This chain connects computational sieving to theoretical impossibility proofs.
Pythagorean graph structure -> quadratic residue constraints -> theta series counting. The graph-theoretic view reveals structural sparsity that modular forms can quantify.
Evolutionary search guided by continued-fraction nearness measures -> identifying promising elliptic curve fibers -> focused rational point search on those fibers.
